no-restricted-syntax.message: Variables initialized with 'await' must have an explicit type annotation (e.g., const result: MyDto = await ...).
Assigning 'await' directly to an existing variable is not allowed; declare a typed const first (e.g., const result: MyDto = await ...).
Functions must have a single return statement at the end of the function body (no early or nested returns).
